title: Tenant schema and search_path state causes GH-359-class failures
notes: Cluster C from the final integration run: TC-TNT-01-01, TC-TNT-01-03, TC-TNT-02-02, TC-TNT-03-01, TC-TNT-03-03, TC-TNT-03-05, and TC-DB-03-01 fail because a tenant table/schema is absent or a connection remains on search_path='public'. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 6384-6503, 8713-8728, and 38774-38872. Follow-on/extension of GitHub #359. Originally registered 2026-08-01 (run_id WF03-gh364-20260801, handoff_id null) by the cluster-registration inner report. Re-associated with the dedicated WF03-gh377-20260804 run on 2026-08-04 (this handoff: dba38f9c-1881-4af3-b765-41fed454dfef).
root_cause: TBD. Initial hypothesis: tenant provisioning and connection checkout do not establish a deterministic tenant schema/search_path state for all integration paths, compounded by shared schema state previously tracked in GitHub #359. Distinct from ISS-0112 (which addressed public.schema_migrations drift in the per-tenant schema reconciliation path) — ISS-0114 targets the per-connection checkout-time search_path and per-tenant fixture provisioning for the seven TC-TNT-* / TC-DB-03-01 cases.
candidate_resolution: Extend the GitHub #359 investigation to reconcile shadow/missing tenant schemas, enforce explicit tenant context before checkout, and add assertions that every checked-out connection resolves the intended schema before unqualified business-table queries.
